title: Integrated Management of Pink Bollworm in Cotton
source_name: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) & MPKV Rahuri
summary: Pink bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella) damages cotton squares and bolls. Proper monitoring using pheromone traps and integrated control measures prevents severe yield loss.
content: Symptoms: Rosette flowers, entrance holes plugged with frass, larval feeding inside bolls causing locule damage and stained lint. Economic Threshold Level (ETL): 8 moths/trap/day for 3 consecutive days or 10% damaged green bolls (1 out of 10 bolls showing larvae or exit holes). Management Actions: 1) Install 5 pheromone traps per hectare at 45 days after sowing for monitoring, 8-10 traps/acre for mass trapping. 2) Release Trichogramma bactrae egg parasitoids @ 1.5 lakh/ha at 10-day intervals from 50-60 DAS. 3) Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Azadirachtin 1500 ppm @ 5 ml/liter water at square initiation. 4) If ETL exceeded, spray recommended insecticides: Profenofos 50% EC @ 30 ml/10L water or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 3 ml/10L water. Safety: Avoid blanket spraying during early stage to conserve beneficial predators like chrysopids and predatory bugs. Never graze cattle in sprayed fields for 15 days.
